Qing.name: Fulin
Qing.title: Shunzhi Emperor
Qing.note: His uncle Dorgon ruled as regent until 1650.

Qing.name: Hongli
Qing.title: Qianlong Emperor
Qing.note: Abdicated in 1796 but kept real power as Retired Emperor until his death in 1799.
Qing.note_zh: 1796年禅位，但以太上皇身份掌权至1799年去世。

Qing.name: Zaichun
Qing.title: Tongzhi Emperor
Qing.note: Empress Dowager Cixi held real power from 1861.

Qing.name: Zaitian
Qing.title: Guangxu Emperor
Qing.note: Empress Dowager Cixi held real power; after 1898 he was kept under house arrest.
Qing.note_zh: 实权在慈禧太后手中，1898年后被软禁。

Qing.name: Puyi
Qing.title: Xuantong Emperor
Qing.note: Abdicated in February 1912, ending imperial rule in China.

Dzungar Khanate.name: Amursana
Dzungar Khanate.title: Amursana (rebel leader)
Dzungar Khanate.note: First helped the Qing against Dawachi, then rebelled; died of smallpox in Russian territory.
Dzungar Khanate.note_zh: 先助清军攻灭达瓦齐，后起兵反清，逃入俄国境内后死于天花。

Korea.name: Yi Cheok
Korea.title: Emperor Sunjong
Korea.note: Korea was annexed by Japan in 1910.

Imperial Japan.name: Osahito
Imperial Japan.title: Emperor Kōmei
Imperial Japan.note: The Tokugawa shoguns still governed until 1867.
Imperial Japan.note_zh: 当时仍由德川幕府执政，直到1867年。

Imperial Japan.name: Mutsuhito
Imperial Japan.title: Emperor Meiji
Imperial Japan.note: The last shogun, Tokugawa Yoshinobu, gave up power in 1867–1868 (Meiji Restoration).
Imperial Japan.note_zh: 末代将军德川庆喜于1867—1868年交出政权（明治维新）。

Tsardom of Muscovy.name: Michael I
Tsardom of Muscovy.title: Tsar Michael Romanov
Tsardom of Muscovy.title_zh: 沙皇米哈伊尔·罗曼诺夫

Tsardom of Muscovy.name: Peter I
Tsardom of Muscovy.title: Peter the Great
Tsardom of Muscovy.note: Co-tsar with Ivan V until 1696, with their sister Sophia as regent until 1689; took the title Emperor in 1721.
Tsardom of Muscovy.note_zh: 1696年前与伊凡五世共治，1689年前由姐姐索菲娅摄政；1721年称皇帝。

Shun.name: Li Zicheng
Shun.title: Prince of Shun
Shun.note: Took Beijing in 1644; driven out by the Qing within weeks and killed in 1645.
Shun.note_zh: 1644年攻入北京，数十日后被清军逐出，1645年死于湖北。

Great Xi.name: Sun Kewang
Great Xi.title: Leader of the Great Xi armies
Great Xi.note: Took Yunnan and Guizhou, then joined the Yongli emperor in 1652.
Great Xi.note_zh: 率大西军据云贵，1652年迎永历帝，联明抗清。

Southern Ming.name: Zhu Youlang
Southern Ming.title: Yongli Emperor (Southern Ming)
Southern Ming.note: Fled to Burma, was handed over to Wu Sangui and killed in 1662.
Southern Ming.note_zh: 逃入缅甸，被交给吴三桂，1662年被杀。

Wu Zhou.name: Wu Sangui
Wu Zhou.title: Prince Pingxi; emperor of 'Zhou' in 1678
Wu Zhou.note: Led the Revolt of the Three Feudatories with Geng Jingzhong and Shang Zhixin.
Wu Zhou.note_zh: 与耿精忠、尚之信发动三藩之乱。

shanhai.note: Qing cavalry charged in late in the day, after Wu Sangui's men had worn down Li's army.
shanhai.note_zh: 吴三桂与大顺军激战多时后，清军骑兵突然杀出，大顺军溃败。

yangzhou-massacre.note: A survivor's account claims 800,000 dead, which is surely too high.
yangzhou-massacre.note_zh: 幸存者王秀楚记载死者达80万，这一数字应有夸大。
yangzhou-massacre.losses: Shi Kefa killed; a huge number of residents massacred
yangzhou-massacre.losses_zh: 史可法殉难，城中百姓惨遭屠戮

koxinga.note: Fort Zeelandia surrendered after a siege of about nine months.
koxinga.note_zh: 热兰遮城被围约九个月后投降。

three-feudatories.note: The war lasted eight years and ended with the fall of Kunming in 1681.
three-feudatories.note_zh: 战争持续八年，1681年昆明城破后结束。

taiwan-1683.note: After the defeat at Penghu, Zheng Keshuang surrendered Taiwan.
taiwan-1683.note_zh: 澎湖战败后，郑克塽献台湾投降。

albazin.note: The sieges led to the Treaty of Nerchinsk in 1689.
albazin.note_zh: 战后双方于1689年签订《尼布楚条约》。

jao-modo.note: Galdan escaped but died the next year.

dzungar.losses: Most of the Dzungar people killed or died of smallpox
dzungar.losses_zh: 准噶尔人大部分死于战争、屠杀和天花

white-lotus.losses: Cost the government about 200 million taels of silver

eight-trigrams.note: Prince Mianning, the future Daoguang Emperor, shot rebels with a musket.
eight-trigrams.note_zh: 皇次子绵宁（后来的道光帝）亲手用鸟枪射杀起事者。

taiping.losses_zh: 死亡数千万人（估计约2000万至3000万）

summer-palace.note: The Qing cavalry was crushed at Baliqiao before the allies reached Beijing.
summer-palace.note_zh: 清军骑兵在八里桥战败，联军随即进逼北京。
summer-palace.losses: The Old Summer Palace looted and burned

battle-fuzhou.losses: About 800 Chinese sailors killed; almost the whole fleet sunk
battle-fuzhou.losses_zh: 约800名中国官兵阵亡，舰队几乎全军覆没

yalu.losses: Beiyang Fleet destroyed; Taiwan ceded to Japan
yalu.losses_zh: 北洋舰队覆灭，台湾被割让给日本

sides.name: Eight-Nation Alliance
sides.troops_text: about 20,000 in the march on Beijing (estimate)
sides.troops_text_zh: 进攻北京时约2万人（估计）

boxers.note: Waldersee, the overall commander, arrived only after Beijing had fallen.
boxers.note_zh: 联军总司令瓦德西到达时北京已被攻占。
boxers.losses: Beijing occupied; the Boxer Protocol imposed huge indemnities
boxers.losses_zh: 北京被占，《辛丑条约》规定巨额赔款

wuchang.note: Qing troops retook Hankou and Hanyang, but the revolt spread to most provinces and the Qing fell.
wuchang.note_zh: 清军虽夺回汉口、汉阳，但各省纷纷响应，清朝最终覆灭。

routes.name: Li Zicheng marches on Beijing
routes.summary: The Shun army crossed the Yellow River, took Taiyuan, Datong and Xuanfu, and entered Beijing in April 1644.
routes.summary_zh: 大顺军东渡黄河，攻克太原、大同、宣府，1644年4月进入北京。

routes.name: Qing army enters the pass
routes.summary: Dorgon's army marched from Shenyang, joined Wu Sangui at Shanhai Pass and took Beijing.
routes.summary_zh: 多尔衮率清军从沈阳出发，在山海关与吴三桂联合，随后进占北京。

routes.name: Dodo's conquest of the south
routes.summary: Qing armies stormed Yangzhou, crossed the Yangtze and took Nanjing and Hangzhou.
routes.summary_zh: 清军攻破扬州，渡过长江，占领南京和杭州。

routes.name: Koxinga crosses to Taiwan
routes.summary: Koxinga's fleet sailed from Kinmen by way of Penghu and landed near the Dutch Fort Zeelandia.
routes.summary_zh: 郑成功船队从金门出发，经澎湖在荷兰人的热兰遮城附近登陆。

routes.name: Qing campaign into Dzungaria
routes.summary: Qing armies advanced along the north side of the Tianshan to the Ili valley.
routes.summary_zh: 清军沿天山北麓西进，直抵伊犁河谷。

routes.name: Tea Road to Kyakhta
routes.summary: Shanxi merchants carried tea from Fujian across China and the Mongolian steppe to trade with Russia at Kyakhta.
routes.summary_zh: 晋商把福建武夷山的茶叶经汉口、张家口，穿越蒙古草原运到恰克图与俄国交易。

routes.name: Taiping march to Nanjing
routes.summary: From Jintian the Taipings marched north to Changsha and Wuchang, then sailed down the Yangtze to take Nanjing.
routes.summary_zh: 太平军从金田起兵，北上长沙、武昌，再顺江东下攻占南京。

routes.name: Anglo-French march on Beijing
routes.summary: Landing at Beitang, the allies took the Dagu Forts and Tianjin, won at Baliqiao and burned the Old Summer Palace.
routes.summary_zh: 联军在北塘登陆，攻占大沽炮台和天津，在八里桥获胜后火烧圆明园。

people.name: Huang Zongxi
people.known_for: Thinker who argued that rulers should serve the people, not the other way round.
people.known_for_zh: 思想家，批判君主专制，主张天下为主、君为客。

people.name: Gu Yanwu
people.known_for: Ming loyalist scholar who urged practical, evidence-based learning.
people.known_for_zh: 明遗民学者，倡导经世致用和实证学风。

people.name: Pu Songling
people.known_for: Wrote hundreds of tales of ghosts, fox spirits and the supernatural.
people.known_for_zh: 写下数百篇鬼狐神怪故事。

works.title: Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio

people.name: Shitao
people.known_for: Ming-prince-turned-monk painter of bold, individual landscapes.
people.known_for_zh: 明宗室后裔出家为僧的画家，山水画风格独特奔放。

people.name: Zheng Banqiao
people.known_for: One of the Eight Eccentrics of Yangzhou, famous for bamboo paintings and quirky calligraphy.
people.known_for_zh: “扬州八怪”之一，以画竹和独特书法闻名。

people.name: Giuseppe Castiglione
people.known_for: Italian Jesuit court painter who blended European and Chinese painting.
people.known_for_zh: 意大利耶稣会士宫廷画家，融合中西画法。

people.name: Wu Jingzi
people.known_for: Satirical novelist who mocked the examination system.
people.known_for_zh: 讽刺小说家，嘲讽科举制度。

people.name: Cao Xueqin
people.known_for: Author of Dream of the Red Chamber, often called the greatest Chinese novel.
people.known_for_zh: 《红楼梦》作者，被誉为中国最伟大的小说。
people.line_zh: 满纸荒唐言，一把辛酸泪。
people.line_en: Pages full of absurd words, a handful of bitter tears.

people.name: Wang Zhenyi
people.known_for: Self-taught woman astronomer and mathematician who explained eclipses with experiments.
people.known_for_zh: 自学成才的女天文学家和数学家，用实验解释月食原理。

people.name: Wei Yuan
people.known_for: Wrote a world geography urging China to learn from the West to resist it.
people.known_for_zh: 编写世界地理著作，提出“师夷长技以制夷”。

works.title: Illustrated Treatise on the Maritime Kingdoms

people.name: Yan Fu
people.known_for: Translator who introduced Darwin and Western thought, coining 'survival of the fittest' in Chinese.
people.known_for_zh: 翻译家，介绍进化论等西方思想，使“物竞天择，适者生存”广为人知。

people.name: Zhan Tianyou
people.known_for: Chief engineer of the Beijing–Zhangjiakou Railway (1909), the first built by Chinese alone.
people.known_for_zh: 京张铁路（1909年）总工程师，这是第一条由中国人自主修建的铁路。

people.name: Qiu Jin
people.known_for: Poet and revolutionary who fought for women's rights; executed in 1907.
people.known_for_zh: 女诗人和革命者，倡导女权，1907年就义。

people.name: Dorgon
people.known_for: Manchu prince-regent who led the Qing into Beijing in 1644 and consolidated its conquest.
people.known_for_zh: 摄政王，1644年率清军入关定鼎北京。

people.name: Kangxi Emperor
people.known_for: Longest-reigning Qing emperor who suppressed the Three Feudatories, annexed Taiwan and patronised learning.
people.known_for_zh: 在位61年，平三藩、收台湾、抗沙俄，开创康乾盛世。

people.name: Yongzheng Emperor
people.known_for: Hard-working emperor who reformed finances and created the Grand Council.
people.known_for_zh: 整顿吏治财政，设立军机处，推行摊丁入亩。

people.name: Qianlong Emperor
people.known_for: Presided over the Qing at its height, expanding into Xinjiang and sponsoring the Siku Quanshu.
people.known_for_zh: 清朝鼎盛时期君主，平定准噶尔，编纂《四库全书》。

people.name: Wu Sangui
people.known_for: Ming general who let the Qing through Shanhai Pass, later led the Revolt of the Three Feudatories.
people.known_for_zh: 引清兵入关，后据云南发动三藩之乱。

people.name: Zheng Chenggong (Koxinga)
people.known_for: Ming loyalist who expelled the Dutch from Taiwan in 1662.
people.known_for_zh: 抗清名将，1662年驱逐荷兰殖民者收复台湾。

people.name: Shi Lang
people.known_for: Admiral who conquered the Zheng kingdom and brought Taiwan under Qing rule in 1683.
people.known_for_zh: 清朝水师提督，1683年攻取台湾。

people.name: Hong Chengchou
people.known_for: Ming commander who defected to the Manchus and directed the Qing conquest of the south.
people.known_for_zh: 明末降清重臣，经略江南西南，助清统一。

people.name: Nian Gengyao
people.known_for: General who pacified Qinghai for Yongzheng before being forced to commit suicide.
people.known_for_zh: 平定青海罗卜藏丹津之乱，后被雍正帝赐死。

people.name: Heshen
people.known_for: Qianlong's favourite minister, notorious for amassing an enormous corrupt fortune.
people.known_for_zh: 乾隆宠臣，贪腐巨富，嘉庆初被赐死抄家。

people.name: Ji Yun
people.known_for: Chief editor of the Siku Quanshu imperial library and author of supernatural tales.
people.known_for_zh: 《四库全书》总纂官，著《阅微草堂笔记》。

people.name: Liu Yong
people.known_for: Grand Secretary and renowned calligrapher, celebrated in folklore for integrity.
people.known_for_zh: 乾嘉重臣，书法大家，民间称“刘罗锅”。

people.name: Lin Zexu
people.known_for: Imperial commissioner whose destruction of opium at Humen in 1839 precipitated the First Opium War.
people.known_for_zh: 1839年虎门销烟，禁烟抗英，“开眼看世界第一人”。

people.name: Zeng Guofan
people.known_for: Raised the Xiang Army that defeated the Taiping and led the Self-Strengthening Movement.
people.known_for_zh: 组建湘军镇压太平天国，洋务运动领袖。

people.name: Li Hongzhang
people.known_for: Self-Strengthening leader who built the Beiyang Fleet and negotiated treaties including Shimonoseki.
people.known_for_zh: 洋务派首领，创建北洋水师，签订《马关条约》等。

people.name: Zuo Zongtang
people.known_for: General who suppressed the Dungan revolt and reconquered Xinjiang in 1876–78.
people.known_for_zh: 平定陕甘回乱，收复新疆，创办福州船政局。

people.name: Hong Xiuquan
people.known_for: Visionary who led the Taiping Rebellion and ruled the Heavenly Kingdom from Nanjing.
people.known_for_zh: 太平天国领袖，自称上帝次子，定都天京。

people.name: Li Xiucheng
people.known_for: Taiping general, the Loyal King, who captured Suzhou and defended Nanjing to the end.
people.known_for_zh: 太平天国忠王，攻取苏州，坚守天京。

people.name: Empress Dowager Cixi
people.known_for: Effective ruler of the late Qing for nearly half a century, who crushed the 1898 reforms.
people.known_for_zh: 垂帘听政近五十年，镇压戊戌变法，晚清实际统治者。

people.name: Guangxu Emperor
people.known_for: Emperor who launched the Hundred Days' Reform in 1898 and was then confined by Cixi.
people.known_for_zh: 1898年推行戊戌变法，失败后被囚瀛台。

people.name: Kang Youwei
people.known_for: Reformist scholar who inspired the Hundred Days' Reform of 1898.
people.known_for_zh: 维新派领袖，发动公车上书，推动戊戌变法。

people.name: Liang Qichao
people.known_for: Reformer and journalist whose writings shaped modern Chinese nationalism.
people.known_for_zh: 维新派代表、启蒙思想家，倡“新民说”。

people.name: Tan Sitong
people.known_for: Reformer executed after the 1898 coup, one of the Six Gentlemen martyrs.
people.known_for_zh: 戊戌六君子之一，变法失败后从容就义。

people.name: Sun Yat-sen
people.known_for: Revolutionary leader of the Tongmenghui whose movement overthrew the Qing in 1911.
people.known_for_zh: 民主革命先行者，创立同盟会，领导推翻清朝。

people.name: Zhang Zhidong
people.known_for: Viceroy who industrialised Wuhan and championed 'Chinese learning as substance, Western learning for use'.
people.known_for_zh: 洋务派重臣，开办汉阳铁厂，倡“中体西用”。

people.name: Yuan Shikai
people.known_for: Trained the modern Beiyang Army and engineered the last emperor's abdication in 1912.
people.known_for_zh: 编练北洋新军，逼清帝退位，后任民国大总统。

people.name: Feng Zicai
people.known_for: Veteran general who defeated the French at Zhennan Pass in 1885.
people.known_for_zh: 中法战争中取得镇南关大捷。

people.name: Liu Mingchuan
people.known_for: First governor of Taiwan Province who built railways and modernised the island.
people.known_for_zh: 首任台湾巡抚，修铁路、办电报，推动台湾近代化。

people.name: Deng Shichang
people.known_for: Captain of the cruiser Zhiyuan who died at the Battle of the Yalu River in 1894.
people.known_for_zh: 致远舰管带，甲午黄海海战中壮烈殉国。

people.name: Wang Fuzhi
people.known_for: Ming loyalist philosopher who wrote on history and materialist metaphysics in seclusion.
people.known_for_zh: 明清之际思想家，隐居石船山著述，人称船山先生。

people.name: Dai Zhen
people.known_for: Leading evidential-research scholar and philosopher who critiqued Neo-Confucian orthodoxy.
people.known_for_zh: 乾嘉考据学大师，批判理学“以理杀人”。

works.title: Evidential Study of the Meaning of Terms in the Mencius

people.name: Duan Yucai
people.known_for: Philologist whose annotated Shuowen Jiezi is the classic of Chinese etymology.
people.known_for_zh: 文字训诂学家，著《说文解字注》。

people.name: Yuan Mei
people.known_for: Poet and gastronome of the Sui Garden who championed spontaneous 'native sensibility' in verse.
people.known_for_zh: 性灵派诗人，隐居随园，著《随园食单》。

works.title: Recipes from the Garden of Contentment

people.name: Nalan Xingde
people.known_for: Manchu aristocrat celebrated as the finest ci lyric poet of the Qing.
people.known_for_zh: 清代第一词人，词风哀感顽艳。

people.name: Li Yu
people.known_for: Playwright, novelist and publisher whose Mustard Seed Garden press issued a famous painting manual.
people.known_for_zh: 戏剧家、小说家，著《闲情偶寄》，主持芥子园书坊。

people.name: Kong Shangren
people.known_for: Descendant of Confucius who wrote the historical drama The Peach Blossom Fan.
people.known_for_zh: 孔子后裔，著传奇《桃花扇》。

people.name: Hong Sheng
people.known_for: Dramatist of The Palace of Eternal Youth, about Emperor Xuanzong and Yang Guifei.
people.known_for_zh: 戏剧家，著传奇《长生殿》，与孔尚任并称“南洪北孔”。

people.name: Zhang Dai
people.known_for: Essayist whose nostalgic sketches recall the lost world of late Ming Jiangnan.
people.known_for_zh: 明清之际散文家，著《陶庵梦忆》《西湖梦寻》。

people.name: Bada Shanren (Zhu Da)
people.known_for: Ming prince turned monk-painter, famed for stark, glaring birds and fish.
people.known_for_zh: 明宗室后裔，号八大山人，写意花鸟孤傲冷峻。

people.name: Jin Nong
people.known_for: Leader of the Eight Eccentrics of Yangzhou, known for his 'lacquer' calligraphy.
people.known_for_zh: 扬州八怪之首，创“漆书”书体。

people.name: Ren Bonian
people.known_for: Leading painter of the Shanghai School, master of lively figures and birds-and-flowers.
people.known_for_zh: 海上画派代表，擅人物花鸟。

people.name: Cheng Changgeng
people.known_for: Anhui troupe star regarded as a founding father of Peking opera.
people.known_for_zh: 京剧奠基人之一，被誉为“京剧鼻祖”。

people.name: Mei Wending
people.known_for: Mathematician and astronomer who synthesised Chinese and Western mathematics.
people.known_for_zh: 清初历算大家，会通中西数学。

works.title: Complete Works on Calendrical Astronomy and Mathematics

people.name: Li Shanlan
people.known_for: Mathematician who translated Euclid, calculus and Newtonian mechanics with Alexander Wylie.
people.known_for_zh: 数学家，与伟烈亚力合译《几何原本》后九卷等。

people.name: Xu Shou
people.known_for: Pioneer of modern chemistry in China who built its first steamship and coined element names.
people.known_for_zh: 近代化学先驱，造中国首艘蒸汽轮船，译化学书。

people.name: Ye Gui (Ye Tianshi)
people.known_for: Physician who systematised the theory of warm diseases.
people.known_for_zh: 温病学派奠基人，提出卫气营血辨证。

people.name: Johann Adam Schall von Bell
people.known_for: German Jesuit astronomer who headed the Qing Imperial Bureau of Astronomy.
people.known_for_zh: 德国耶稣会士，执掌清钦天监，修订《时宪历》。

people.name: Ferdinand Verbiest
people.known_for: Flemish Jesuit who rebuilt the Beijing Observatory instruments and tutored the Kangxi Emperor.
people.known_for_zh: 比利时耶稣会士，主持钦天监，制造观象台天文仪器。

people.name: Robert Hart
people.known_for: British Inspector-General of the Chinese Maritime Customs for nearly half a century.
people.known_for_zh: 英国人，任清海关总税务司近半个世纪。

people.name: George Macartney
people.known_for: Led Britain's 1793 embassy to the Qianlong Emperor at Chengde, which failed to open trade.
people.known_for_zh: 率英国使团觐见乾隆帝，要求通商被拒。

people.name: Song Yingxing
people.known_for: Wrote an illustrated encyclopedia of crafts and technology in 1637.
people.known_for_zh: 1637年写成图文并茂的工艺技术百科全书。

works.title: The Exploitation of the Works of Nature

people.name: Chen Hongshou
people.known_for: Late Ming figure painter known for stylised, archaic figures and woodblock designs.
people.known_for_zh: 明末人物画大家，造型奇古，与崔子忠并称“南陈北崔”。

people.name: Wu Youxing
people.known_for: Physician who proposed that epidemics are caused by external pestilential agents.
people.known_for_zh: 温病学家，提出“戾气”致疫学说。

capitals.name: Beijing
capitals.note: The Qing moved their capital from Shenyang in 1644.

capitals.name: Xi'an
capitals.note: Li Zicheng proclaimed the Shun here, then briefly held Beijing.
capitals.note_zh: 李自成在此建立大顺，曾短暂占领北京。

capitals.name: Zhaoqing
capitals.note: The Yongli Emperor was enthroned here and later moved many times.
capitals.note_zh: 永历帝在此即位，后多次转移。

capitals.name: Tainan (Chengtian)
capitals.note: Koxinga's family ruled Taiwan from here.
capitals.note_zh: 郑成功家族在此统治台湾。

capitals.name: Kashgar
capitals.note: Yaqub Beg's regime until the Qing reconquest.
capitals.note_zh: 清军收复前的阿古柏政权。

capitals.name: Tokyo
capitals.note: Capital of Meiji Japan from 1868 (still the capital today).
capitals.note_zh: 1868年起为明治日本首都（至今仍是）。

capitals.name: Nanjing
capitals.note: Provisional government under Sun Yat-sen, January to April 1912.
capitals.note_zh: 孙中山领导的临时政府（1912年1月至4月）。
